laws.rule: Foreign visitors entering Tanzania through Zanzibar must buy Zanzibar Insurance Corporation inbound travel insurance (USD 44 per adult, USD 22 per child, valid 92 days), even with other insurance; one policy covers both Zanzibar and the mainland.

Smartraveller says dress and behaviour standards are conservative in Tanzania, especially in Zanzibar. For women it advises against shorts or sleeveless tops outside resorts, and says to take care to be respectful.
